summary: Phase 3 OMR Scanning testing completed successfully. All backend endpoints (omr-students, omr-scan, omr-scan PUT, omr-results, omr-register-grades) and frontend UI components (OMRScanCard, OMRResultsCard, ESCANEAR button) verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing OMR exam: 7b859047-f6cb-4760-b945-2e17b58c0099 (10 questions, 4 options, answer_key configured, 3 existing scans)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 OMR Scanning is complete. The exam has 3 scans with grades 20, 17.3 avg, 12 lowest. The register_column is not set, so register-grades returns 400 as expected.

GET /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-students.details: Returns student list with scan status (has_scan, scan_score, scan_total)

POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-scan.details: Processes image, returns 409 for duplicate student scan, 400 for non-OMR exams, 400 if no answer_key

PUT /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-scan/{scan_.details: Overwrites existing scan with new image processing

GET /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-results.details: Returns all scan results with student names, grades, registration status

POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-register-g.details: Returns 400 if register_column not set, registers grades when configured

exam_listing_escanear_button.details: OMR exams with answer_key show purple 'ESCANEAR' button with camera icon

omr_scan_card.details: OMRScanCard shows 'Escanear examenes' title with 'Escanear hoja' button

omr_results_card.details: OMRResultsCard shows scan count, average/highest/lowest grades, register button

omr_sheet_card.details: Shows 'Hoja OMR generada' with date, 'Descargar PDF' and 'Regenerar' buttons

answer_key_editor.details: Shows bubble grid with 10 questions, 4 options (A-D), all configured
